name: Ootori Chihaya
source: A girl who suddenly transferred to the school [url=/c267]Kotarou[/url] attends. She has led a sheltered life and is ignorant of the ways of the world. Considerably clumsy and easily getting lost, Kotarou always helps her out, but with her personality that can't stay meek they can't stop quarreling. Called a "power fighter" for being really strong physically.
